name: How long does a typical siding damage assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical siding damage assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a siding damage assessment can vary based on the size of your home, the accessibility of the siding, and the suspected extent of the damage. For an average-sized residential property, a thorough assessment typically takes between 1 to 3 hours. More complex cases, or homes with difficult access, might require additional time. The contractor will usually inform you of the expected timeframe when scheduling the appointment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical siding damage assessment usually takes 1 to 3 hours, depending on home size and damage complexity.
